Question: What is the VMRS code for vent, cab exhaust?
Query_1: MATCH (n) WHERE n.name =~ '(?i).*vent.*' OR n.description =~ '(?i).*vent.*' RETURN n.code as code, n.name as name, n.description as description, labels(n)[0] as type LIMIT 20
Query_2: MATCH (n:Component) WHERE (n.name =~ '(?i).*cab.*exhaust.*' OR n.description =~ '(?i).*cab.*exhaust.*') AND n.code STARTS WITH '001-004' RETURN n.code as code, n.name as name, n.description as description
Query_3: MATCH (n:Component) WHERE n.code STARTS WITH '001-004' RETURN n.code as code, n.name as name, n.description as description LIMIT 20
